(defn by_category []
  (reduce (fn [out e] (update out (get e "category") (fn [v] (cents (+ (or v 0) (get e "amount"))))))
          {} (get (state) "expenses")))

(defn add_expense [amount category]
  (when-not (and (number? amount) (pos? amount)) (throw (ex-info "amount must be positive" {})))
  (when-not (and (string? category) (not= "" category)) (throw (ex-info "category required" {})))
  (swap-state! update "expenses" (fnil conj []) {"amount" amount "category" category})
  (count (get (state) "expenses")))

(defn set_budget [category amount]
  (swap-state! assoc-in ["budgets" category] amount)
  amount)

(defn top_category []
  (let [spent (by_category)]
    (reduce (fn [best c] (if (or (nil? best) (> (get spent c) (get spent best))) c best))
            nil (sort (keys spent)))))
